$comment: AUDIT of coordinates whose only ratification comes from a minimal MULTI-coordinate witness. A holding 2-set is guaranteed minimal — checkWitness raises NOT_MINIMAL when either coordinate alone already collides the stimuli — so for every coordinate here the harness has positively established that erasing it ALONE does not destroy the distinction. That is the retention criterion failing, and `ratifiedSet` was reading it as passing. What such a witness does prove is that the SEMANTIC DISTINCTION is real; what stays open is the factorization. The earlier witness record is deliberately NOT altered: stage 1.5 adjudicated under the older rule and closed, and rewriting a finished experiment's result from outside it is the thing this slice refuses everywhere else. The question is asked here instead.

dispositions.unresolved: not yet adjudicated; the close condition is zero of these
dispositions.witnessed: a holding witness in witnesses.json ratifies it against the frozen oracle
dispositions.representation-artifact: erasing it cannot collapse two representations, because another coordinate already carries the distinction; the census measured the encoding rather than a degree of freedom
dispositions.not-yet-admitted: no active authority requires the distinction it names; it leaves the kernel with the earliest stage allowed to re-earn it
dispositions.required-derived-vocabulary: no independent semantic degree of freedom — it is wholly derivable from other semantic facts — but external authority governs the NAME, so the coordinate legitimately stays in the kernel. The only decided verdict that does not expect the coordinate to disappear.

outcomes.$comment: The three ways an entry can resolve. Naming them in advance keeps the audit from defaulting to the most convenient one.
outcomes.bothReEarned: each coordinate has its own holding single-coordinate falsifier; the 2-set was incidental, and both are primitive
outcomes.onePrimitiveOneDerived: one carrier holds the degree of freedom and the other is derivable from it — required derived vocabulary, or a representation artifact
outcomes.compositeePrimitive: neither is primitive in its current form: the semantic primitive is a composite the schema decomposed into two mutually dependent coordinates. A semantic distinction can be irreducible while every coordinate in its current encoding is reducible

basis.reason: the commit at which primitive ratification was separated from interaction evidence, which is what made this population visible; measured, not enumerated by hand

measurements.$comment: Evidence gathered for the audit, before any verdict. Stimuli vary only the additivity declaration and the assertion shape, both of which stage-2 causes already range over, so no new authority is invented.

observationalPartition.$comment: Each declaration crossed with the assertion shapes the stage-2 additivity causes reach, plus being the field a `normalize` rescales. Cell = the diagnostics produced.

classes.behaviour: SUM_SEMIADDITIVE on sum along d1 and on sum with no along
SUM_SEMIADDITIVE on sum along d2 and on sum with no along
SUM_SEMIADDITIVE on either along and on sum with no along
NORMALIZE_NONADDITIVE only when it is a normalize field
RATIO_MEASURE_AVERAGED on sum and on mean

findings: SIX classes over seven declarations: `<absent>` and `additive` are observationally identical under every stimulus reached. Relevant to field.additivity#present in the holders basis — holder presence is observable through the OTHER three branches, not through `additive`.
The three semi[...] variants are mutually distinct, so which dimensions are blocked is real content.

The observable content factorizes into three independent facts: the set of dimensions along which summation is illegal, whether the mean is illegal, and whether normalizing the field is illegal. The tag makes them MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE — a measure cannot be declared both semi-additive along a dimension and a ratio-measure. No stage-2 cause exercises that exclusivity, so it is unwitnessed rather than wrong; recorded here as an observation, not a verdict.

supportStatus.$comment: Every live additivity coordinate, by the strength of its support.
supportStatus.controlledComparison: EVERY interaction-only pair has `semi-additive` as a member, and `semi-additive` is the only branch carrying payload. The control is `additive~ratio-measure`: same enum, same rules, both branches tag-only, and it has a holding SINGLE-coordinate witness. So the 2-set requirement tracks payload shape, not semantic entanglement — substituting a payload-carrying member alone leaves the payload behind, and the second coordinate erases that remnant.

witnessClassification.$comment: Every holding multi-coordinate witness, run through the five conditions. Measured, not argued.

results.failed: condition 1 — `assertion.kind` is a bare LEAF, not a member pair, so there is no tag rewrite for residue to be conditional on
condition 5 UNAVAILABLE — `Assertion` has exactly two branches, so C(2,2)=1 and the pair under test is the only member pair the enum has. Conditions 1-4 all held.

witnessClassification.finding: The assertion cluster was chosen as the independent falsifier and cannot serve as one: its discriminator is structurally incapable of supplying a control. Conditions 1-4 held there, so the MECHANISM looks the same, but the test is inconclusive rather than confirming. Quotient-hygiene therefore rests on a single enum so far and must not yet be generalized to the twenty derivedBy.kind pairs — though `Derivation` has seven members and `bin~normalize` is a ratified single-coordinate control, so unlike `Assertion` it CAN be tested.

cleanupCardinality.$comment: Erasing a discriminator rewrites one member's tag to the other's. Required payload each branch carries that the other does not is RESIDUE: it survives the rewrite and keeps the two encodings out of the same comparison class. The smallest raw erasure set is therefore 1 + the residue on each side. A fact about branch topology, not about any judgment.
cleanupCardinality.finding: 20 of 21 pairs have residue on BOTH sides. Only the control is expressible within the <=2-coordinate witness contract. So a bespoke two-set search for any of the twenty is futile BEFORE it runs, and recording `interaction` for one would be a false negative: it would report a semantic difference where the test merely failed to erase the second branch's residue. Pinned by test (C1d).

derivationEnumProbe.$comment: NON-RATIFYING probe. It never entered witnesses.json, primitiveRatified, interactionProven, or any verdict, and its stimuli are not fixtures. Its only question: do the five hygiene conditions generalize to a second enum when residue exists on BOTH branches — a shape the <=2-coordinate contract cannot express?
derivationEnumProbe.stimuli: Two structures differing in NOTHING but the `derivedBy` object (verified structurally). a: project keep[country, amount] over a nest declaring levels [country, state] -> REL_DERIVATION_DISCARDS_MEMBERSHIP + grain:declared, grounded in CASE_FLATTENING_DISCARDS_NEST_MEMBERSHIP. b: aggregate-to-grain toGrain[country], a declared prefix of that hierarchy -> no finding. Both readings mechanical over existing stage-2 causes.

conditions.1-one-discriminator-substitution: held — the carrier is the only tag rewrite
conditions.2-cleanup-is-branch-conditional-payload: held — both cleanups are under relation.derivedBy.<member>.
conditions.3-carrier-alone-does-not-collide: held — measured; and neither single cleanup suffices, so the cleanup set is minimal
conditions.4-cleanup-alone-does-not-supply-the-diff: held — measured: no collision without the carrier
conditions.5-same-enum-control-separates-on-one-coo: held — bin~normalize is PRIMITIVE, a holding single-coordinate witness
conditions.6-cleanup-bears-no-standing: held FOR NOW — both cleanup coordinates are `unresolved` in the stage-2 basis, so the split demotes nothing that has earned its place

derivationEnumProbe.result: All conditions hold. Quotient hygiene is independently observed on a SECOND enum, with residue on both branches, so raw edit cardinality was measuring serialization cleanup rather than semantic content. The additivity case is no longer the sole instance.
derivationEnumProbe.provisionality: Condition 6 is a dependency, not a proof: the cleanup coordinates are UNRESOLVED, not proven standing-free. If either later earns primitive standing, this classification becomes false and must be re-decided — the same shape of provisionality the `final-quotient` close condition carries.
derivationEnumProbe.notClaimed: Semantic-erasure closure is NOT adopted by this probe, the <=2-coordinate witness bound is unchanged, no coordinate gained or lost standing, and none of the twenty pairs is classified. Adopting closure would mean separating the semantic carrier from its deterministic normalization in the witness form itself, with its own proof obligations — a change to what the apparatus can conclude, which this probe was designed to inform rather than perform.

openQuestion.$comment: The audit's three precommitted outcomes may not exhaust the cases. The measurement suggests a fourth, and it is recorded as a QUESTION rather than adopted, because adding an outcome class changes what the audit can conclude and that should not be decided by the party running it.
openQuestion.statement: A minimal 2-set can arise for two different reasons. (a) TRUE INTERACTION: two coordinates jointly carry a distinction neither carries alone. (b) SUBSTITUTION HYGIENE: one coordinate carries the distinction and the second is only required to make the erasure well-formed, because the members have different payload shapes and rewriting one to the other leaves a remnant. Under (b) the second coordinate is canonical-form cleanup, not a co-equal carrier of meaning, and reading the 2-set as evidence about IT would be as wrong as reading it as ratification.
openQuestion.discriminator: Compare against a control pair from the same enum whose branches are both tag-only. If that control has a single-coordinate witness while the payload-involving pairs need 2-sets, the 2-set tracks payload shape rather than semantics. For additivity the control is `additive~ratio-measure`, and it does.
openQuestion.consequenceIfAdopted: It would also apply to the twenty derivedBy.kind pairs, whose members likewise have different required key-sets — and it would make `bin~normalize` the control for THAT enum, since it is the only pair there with matching payload shape and it holds on a single coordinate.
